title: Li Jingwei
text:
Welcome! My name is Jingwei Li. I am a fourth-year PhD candidate in Economics at Singapore Management University.
My research interests are in Empirical Industrial Organization, Public Economics, and Consumer Choice. I am particularly interested in how competition, pricing, and market institutions shape firm behavior and consumer outcomes, with a focus on healthcare and retail markets.
I am advised by Prof. Aljoscha Janssen.
You can find my CV here.
